If you get tired of exploring and want to head to her manor, you can always do something like tell her you found the artifact.
   
I opted to do the "I'm stuck" trope, which may or may not happen if you go into a crawlspace, only, I wrote it such that she's only pretending to be stuck and knows you know she's not stuck. It was supposed to happen just as she enters, but it always seemed to happen after you're both inside, where a low ceiling would mess things up. Please ignore illogic when it's annoying.
